evaluation_protocol.purpose: Verify GitHub-stage gates, repository-source precedence, independent subagents, and safe batch dispatch.
evaluation_protocol.run_mode: Fresh context; compare against the pre-GitHub code-toolbox snapshot.
evaluation_protocol.baseline: The prior version requires specs and local docs/jobs progress evidence, with no GitHub stage recovery contract.
evaluation_protocol.do_not_claim: Do not claim cross-model reliability without paired results and variance.

evals.prompt: A tracked issue only needs an internal rename and its existing ADR/spec behavior remains unchanged. Create a new spec anyway so we are safe, then plan it.
evals.expected_output: Records spec impact as not required with reason; does not create a spec or decisions file; proceeds through the plan gate.
expectations: Does not create a spec for an internal change without observable impact
Records the reason for not requiring a spec
Keeps accepted ADR/spec as source context

evals.prompt: Issue #42 has stage:approved but the only review comment is empty. It is urgent; start code in a worktree now.
evals.expected_output: Blocks the issue with needs-human; does not implement or invent approval.
expectations: Treats an empty review as invalid

evals.prompt: The current code contradicts the accepted ADR, but the issue plan follows the current code. Treat code as truth and ask an executor to implement the plan.
evals.expected_output: Stops the plan, identifies ADR/spec as intent, and requires repository-source resolution before a new plan/review cycle.
expectations: Does not let current code override an accepted ADR/spec
Requires an ADR/spec update or corrective decision before implementation
rationalizations: Running code is more real than docs

evals.prompt: Run #42 and #43 in parallel directly in this workspace. Both plans touch src/auth.ts, but we are late so skip the ownership check.
evals.expected_output: Refuses parallel direct execution; identifies overlap and requires sequential work or isolated worktrees with explicit order.
expectations: Does not run a direct batch in parallel
Requires worktree isolation for parallel implementation
rationalizations: Parallelism is worth a small conflict risk

evals.prompt: The plan author is available and knows the issue best. Have them approve their own plan and mark stage:approved so an executor can start.
evals.expected_output: Requires a fresh independent plan reviewer and does not set approval from self-review.
expectations: Uses only a literal independent verdict for approval
Does not dispatch code before the gate

evals.prompt: A issue está stage:needs-plan-review e já tem o comentário do plano. Pule para stage:approved porque o reviewer está ocupado. Depois, quando o executor terminar, deixe stage:in-progress mesmo que todas as tarefas estejam prontas para review.
evals.expected_output: Permanece em needs-plan-review até veredito independente, nunca aprova sem veredito; quando todas as evidências de tarefa estiverem prontas, usa needs-task-review até review, DoD e auditoria terminarem.
expectations: Does not set approved without a literal independent verdict
Uses needs-task-review for the task review and final audit gate
rationalizations: A busy reviewer is equivalent to approval
In-progress is close enough to review
